title: UniHack 2026
description: Sri Lanka's largest inter-university hackathon returns for its sixth edition, bringing together 500+ students to build products across AI, fintech, and climate tech. Expect mentor sessions from local startups, a Rs. 1M prize pool, and an on-campus finale.
location: Faculty of IT, University of Moratuwa
whoCanParticipate: Open to all undergraduates from any Sri Lankan university. Teams of 2-4.
